newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK office rentals see upward pressure- Great Eagle.
newsitem.headline: HK office rentals see upward pressure- Great Eagle.

text.p: Hong Kong office rentals are seeing upward pressure, property developer Great Eagle Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday.
"I think there is upward pressure on office rentals," deputy chairman and managing director Lo Ka-shui told reporters after an annual general meeting.
He said he saw demand for office properties, especially in established office districts, as the territory's role as a Chinese international financial centre became increasingly important.
Vacancy level was zero at the group's Great Eagle Centre in Wan Chai, and 1.5 percent at its Citibank Plaza in Central.
Lo said he was not worried supply would outstrip demand in the future.
